title: IPW estimator — estimate_beta_ipw

IPW estimator consistent model \(C | (Y, Z)\) mean outcome model correctly specified. sandwich standard errors account estimating weights.

title: Maximum likelihood estimator (MLE) — estimate_beta_mle
text: Estimates \(\theta = (\beta, \sigma)\) parameters \(\gamma\) Weibull AFT model \(X | Z\) (model_xz) together, maximizing observed-data likelihood. censored row, likelihood integrates \(f_{Y|X,Z} f_{X|Z}\) \(x > W\) 64-node Gauss-Legendre rule. MLE estimates \(\gamma\) together \(\theta\) estimating equations \(\gamma\) involve \(\theta\) \(f_{Y|X,Z}\); fitting model \(X | Z\) \((W, D, Z)\) alone first, two-step MLE , gives biased estimator outcome-dependent censoring. MLE use model \(C | (Y, Z)\); model_weights used starting values. MLE consistent \(f_{Y|X,Z}\), including normal errors, \(f_{X|Z}\) correctly specified.

title: ODRCC 0.2.0
text: estimators now match revised manuscript code simulations/. estimators estimate theta = (beta, sigma) jointly return sandwich standard errors directly se_est. var_beta_*() functions removed. estimate_beta_mle() joint MLE: Weibull model X | Z estimated jointly outcome model (64-node Gauss-Legendre integration). estimate_beta_aipw() (unguarded AIPW) takes working model f_{X|Y,Z} joint MLE (fx_method = "joint", default) Weibull AFT model X | (Y, Z) (fx_method = "direct"). estimate_beta_aipw_lambda() (guarded AIPW) uses working normal model moments fitted Weibull model X | Z. standard errors IPW AIPW estimators account estimating model C | (Y, Z). New ess_weights(): effective sample size IPW weights. data_aft() now generates design first simulation study, arguments c_int (censoring rate) p.c (spread log C). number covariates outcome model, model_xz, model_weights.
